angularDiameterSource: No angular diameter is measured: this is the record's radius at the Gaia distance.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 source 3009908378049913216: parallax 37.2539 +/- 0.0195 mas (RUWE 0.92), inverted to 26.8429 pc with no zero-point correction.
radiusSource: Temperature 6076 +180/-92 K from the high-resolution spectroscopic analysis of Baburaj et al. (2026, arXiv:2608.15912), and stellar mass 1.20 +/- 0.06 solar masses from their Table 1. Radius 1.25 +/- 0.06 solar radii from Kervella et al. (2004), the value Franson et al. (2023, arXiv:2302.05420) adopt: 869,625 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. GM from 1.20 solar masses times the JPL solar GM. presentationUp: the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up; no spin axis is measured on the sky.
effectiveTemperatureSource: 6076 +180/-92 K, Baburaj et al. (2026), section 5.1, https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15912

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius. The star's disc is not resolved; its colour is Gaia's spectrum of it.
